cohort: 213 women in China who had a vaginal twin delivery between January 2016 and July 2020.
finding: There was no difference in the risk of admission to NICU or a low 5-minute Apgar score between infants in the vertex-vertex presentation group and the vertex-breech presentation group after adjusting for confounding factors.
mod_finding: Infants in the vertex-breech group had a higher incidence of admission to NICU and lower 1-min and 5-minute Apgar scores for the second twin, but these differences were no longer significant after adjusting for confounding factors.
